launcherGuarantees: A genuine actual-run object is minted only after real bwrap/strace execution; JSON verified=true is not accepted.
stdin is the self-opened actual /dev/null char1:3; stdout/stderr pipe-inodes are owned and captured by Popen.
The role/root/cwd, exact trace SHA, actual producer executable SHA, strace/bwrap SHAs and actual kernel/boot context remain bound.
Source slots are RO. Only the outside trace-evidence directory is writable; no hidden inverse graph or source overlay is introduced.

runtimeProvenance.profileBinding: Actual trace SHA, actual tool/kernel match, declared path occurrence and EBADF-probe occurrence are checked against the same factory-minted run.
runtimeProvenance.selfPathBinding: Actual /proc/<traced-thread-group>/cgroup/maps FD identity; exe readlink must equal the actual traced executable. No arbitrary PID or prefix accepted.
runtimeProvenance.operations: Only explicitly declared observed operations; missing path or operation fails. The two cgroup absence probes require actual ENOENT.
runtimeProvenance.fdControl: Precisely observed F_SETFD FD_CLOEXEC EBADF probes on unbound3..16 descriptors and traced own pipe/eventfd origins, not unclassified external byte inputs.
runtimeProvenance.metadataOnlyAncestors: Exact listed statx metadata operations; directory contents are not allowed and the actual /dev/shm enumeration counterexample fails.

additionalCounterexamples: Actual hostfile, /proc/self/root hostfile, external alias and host-directory reads are performed by Node then rejected for both physical roles.

Wrong role, forged launch JSON, changed actual trace, runtime-without-launch, wrong producer SHA, wrong kernel, wrong runtime trace SHA, missing runtime path/operation are rejected as separate provenance mutations.
Unmeasured prefix, /proc/self/root, other PID maps and fake launcher construction reject.
stillRequiredBeforeProduction: The genuine externally pinned SourceA verifier must execute in the upstream factory; lower-level FileBinding/ReadContract values do not certify the actual164/593/8584 production proof.
Verify actual prepared private-capture mount sources and dependency/tool bindings; these direct-file fixtures do not prove that physical integration.
Run genuine native TS/Deep/CQR producers and their real selected/discovered closure; tiny .mjs discovery is not those producers.
Provide reviewed environment-specific measured runtime and exact metadata profiles; no global exception for another Node/kernel/environment.
No claim of arbitrary-Linux-syscall security, general external-writer ABA protection, complete immutable OS state or confidential-host sandbox.
